summary: Very steep residential street, about 20% grade, with homes 10-13 m away.

best_section.where: Highview Terrace just up from the main road junction

drivers.seclusion: Houses front the kerb on both sides, with a dwelling 13 m away near the start.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, few cars parked; steep and narrow beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side street off a busy road.
drivers.convention: No parked-overnight convention seen; occasional cars at kerb.

sun_shade: Mostly open at the start, patchy tree shade from the north side.
